senses.gloss: अच् (I) vt. 1U (pp. अक्त; pres. अचति-ते) 1. To go, to move; 2. to speak indistinctly.

अच् (II) vt. 1P (pp. अक्त in the first sense, अञ्चित in the second; pres. अञ्चति) 1. To go; 2. to honour, to worship.With अप-, to run away, to retreat.With उद्-, 1. to go up; 2. to rise, उदञ्चन्मात्सर्य &c. G.L.6.With नि-, 1. to bend down; 2. to lessen, न्यञ्चति वयसि प्रथमे (when childhood was gradually passing away) Bh.V.ii.47.With परा-, go back, Bh.V.i.65.With परि-, to go about.
